goal: Add point-in-time, market-blind features that improve out-of-sample prediction of the closing spread residual.

protocol.evaluation: chronological walk-forward within holdout; no future data

success_criteria.anchor_test: Same as ChatGPT #1954: weight on the feature residual > 0 with 95% season-clustered CI entirely above 0
success_criteria.rmse: Holdout RMSE of (feature-augmented prediction) strictly below RMSE of closing spread alone

features: qb_status: starter continuity, injured/backup-QB flag, backup career EPA/play
talent: 247 composite team talent and difference
schedule_spot: rest days, travel miles, time-zone change, off a bye
rules: Nothing reaches the card until success criteria are met.
Report every attempt with its metrics.
Do not merge until the protocol succeeds or the attempt budget is exhausted.
